roundOneFindings.finding: Not self-contained (track/active face only under prototype scopes)
roundOneFindings.note: .st-segment carries the well track, line border, paper face, weight 500 and ink underline; the scoped rules are deleted from bundle.css and prototype CSS.
Every Segment button measured 48px tall at 390 (preview, farrowing.room, piglet list, inspection walk, condition picker, Pigs/Pens, parity facet, environment).
Variant documented; Diseases/Symptoms and Pigs/Pens now call SentriUI.segment; Pigs/Pens counts dropped (the header already says 3 pens · 7 pigs).
TaskLens renders SentriUI.segment variant two-line-lens plus an IconButton.

An :active rule exists, but --press (#f1f5eb) on the --well track (#eef1e7) is a 3-4 RGB step: invisible on an unselected option; on the selected option it removes the paper face so it reads as deselected.
Arrows/Home/End/Enter/Space documented and wired; disabled options skipped.

reversals: None. Round 1 asked the owner whether Done belongs in the chip row; the owner chose a To do / Done lens above the chips, which this round accepts.

checklist.why: Purpose plus 'use FilterChips instead for dynamic tag filters'.
When per variant; when-not names FilterChips, ChoiceList, Button.
Track, buttons, label, optional count, underline, reason line named and shown.

Lens and two-line lens have the same when-to-use (states of one list with counts); only the look differs, so nothing tells a builder which to pick (Piglet uses one-line, Farrowing two-line for the same job).
Pressed is drawn with --press, indistinguishable from --well on an unselected option; the static demo presses the selected option, which then looks unselected.
All Segment buttons 48px tall, narrowest 67px (5-option parity facet) at 390.
2-5 stated, view switch 2-3; the ended death sheet omits the single-option switch.
Selected = weight + ink underline; disabled = dashed outline + reason line.
Length/casing/wrap rules stated; the Chinese example renders without clipping (though it does not actually wrap at demo width).
role=group + aria-pressed, token focus ring, arrow/Home/End row.
New .st-segment rules resolve to tokens; tokens listed in the README.
Related (FilterChips, ChoiceList, IconButton, TaskLens adapter) and classification stated.
Four variant documents, six states each, no overflow at 375 (cgate/Segment/variant-*.png).

variants.name: lens (inline count)
findings: Same job as two-line lens with a different look; Piglet's To do / Done lens does not look like Farrowing's room lens.
Piglet's lens takes its accessible name from chips.label ('Show pens that need'), the chips' name.
environment.page tags Today / 7 days as lens; it is a period switch (view switch), not list states.

variants.name: two-line lens (count under label, beside the filter IconButton)
findings: Pressed fill invisible on unselected tabs (shared token issue).

variants.name: view switch
findings: Condition picker: .st-selection{flex:1} grows the wrapper to 220px in the sheet's column flex, leaving a ~160px empty gap above the search field.
Environment page: the sensor switch sits flush on the card below (no gap) since the old margin went with .sensor-tabs.
Fan Auto/Manual on the same page is still a hand-built 40px .device-mode copy with raw colours.

variants.name: facet
findings: The atlas says 'No screen uses this yet'; the parity facet in the Filter sows sheet is its user.

findings.text: .st-selection{flex:1} stretches vertically in a column flex parent: the Choose conditions sheet shows the Diseases/Symptoms switch, then ~160px of empty space before Search (st-selection 354x220, track 56).
findings.fix: Make the wrapper flex:none by default and flex:1 only inside a row bar (.tk-lens-bar>.st-selection, .room-lensbar>.st-selection, .inspect-controls>.st-selection).

findings.text: Press feedback is imperceptible: --press #f1f5eb vs --well #eef1e7 on unselected options; on the selected option it replaces the paper face so the tap looks like a deselect.
findings.fix: Press unselected buttons with a darker token on the well (--choice-press or a new --press-on-well) and skip the press fill on aria-pressed=true; demo Pressed on an unselected option.

findings.text: Lens vs two-line lens differ only in look; Piglet's To do / Done lens is one-line while Farrowing's room lens is two-line for the same job, against the farrowing-parity rule.
findings.fix: Merge into one lens (two-line), or state the rule (two-line when beside the filter IconButton or with 3+ options) and render Piglet's lens two-line.

findings.text: Piglet list budget: Done 3 repeats the task card's '3 / 12 pens done', and every row under the To do lens still wears a 'To do' pill.
findings.fix: Drop the row status pill while a single-state lens is active; keep one done figure (lens count or card, not both).

findings.text: Environment page: the sensor view switch touches the card below; Today/7 days is labelled lens; Fan Auto/Manual is still hand-built (.device-mode, 40px, raw #edf0e7/white).
findings.fix: Give the host a space-token gap; set variant:'view-switch' for the period; replace .device-mode with SentriUI.segment view-switch (or ChoiceList if it records a setting).

findings.text: Dead copies remain: ux/system/sentri-components.js still defines segment(); sentri-visual-foundation.css still styles .room-tabs/.segment/.scope-tabs/.health-tabs with #fff and 44px. Neither is loaded, but they read as a second implementation.
findings.fix: Delete the segment() copy and the three scoped selector rules.

proposals.name: Segment lens + two-line lens -> one lens
proposals.why: Same job, same data; two looks in two sections invite drift. If both are kept, the README must state when each applies.

proposals.name: Environment fan Auto/Manual (.device-mode) into Segment view switch
proposals.why: Same look and job as Segment, hand-built at 40px with raw colours, on a screen already migrated.
